luis-hector-chavez.bio: Luis Héctor Chávez is the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) at Replit, where he leads the charge in redefining what’s possible in online coding environments. A passionate engineer and builder, Luis previously worked on enabling Android applications to run on Chrome OS—bridging ecosystems and expanding platform capabilities. When he's not architecting the future of software development, you’ll likely find him riding his bicycle and exploring the outdoors.

thomas-dohmke.bio: Fascinated by software development since his childhood in Germany, Thomas Dohmke has built a career creating tools developers love. Based out of Seattle, Washington, Thomas is the CEO and co-founder of Entire, the world's next developer platform in the era of AI. Formerly, Thomas was Chief Executive Officer of GitHub, where he led the company's growth to over 150 million developers and oversaw the rise of GitHub Copilot — the world's most widely adopted AI developer tool — now with over 20 million users and counting. Thomas is a celebrated TED speaker and holds a PhD in mechanical engineering from the University of Glasgow, UK.

dona-sarkar.role: Chief Troublemaker - Microsoft Enterprise AI Advocacy
dona-sarkar.bio: Dona believes that you are one experiment away from being your most powerful self at work. And yes, in life! Currently at her day job, she's running 100 experiments as the Chief Troublemaker of the Microsoft AI and Copilot Extensibility Program. Her goal is that people all over the world can use Microsoft's AI and Copilot programs to reason over their OWN data and truly make AI useful for their business. Dona is also a keynote speaker (fave audience is corporate leaders like YOU), a multi-published author (it turns out fiction writing is useful in software!), the owner of the ethical luxury fashion brand called Prima Dona Studios, and she has recently become a wine bar co-owner and is studying to be a sommelier. A few years ago, she was named one of Fast Company's 100 Most Productive People and Cosmopolitan magazine's Businessperson of the Year for her multi-faceted (aka weird) life. And yes, she is always ready to get on a plane and come see YOU.

viktoria-semaan.bio: Viktoria Semaan is a Principal Technical Evangelist and AI Engineer with over 15 years of experience across cloud technologies, engineering, and management consulting. A recognized AI/ML Top Voice on LinkedIn and one of the leading global cloud influencers, Viktoria is known for turning cutting-edge AI advancements into practical tools and business value. She currently helps developers and enterprises adopt next-generation AI services, leading hands-on initiatives in multi-agent systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and modern AI toolchains. Her work bridges technical depth with strategic vision, accelerating how teams build and scale with AI. Viktoria holds an MBA from UCLA Anderson and completed an entrepreneurship program at HEC Paris. She is a frequent keynote speaker at major developer conferences worldwide, where she shares actionable strategies on applied AI, developer experience, and innovation at scale. With a following of over 630,000 tech professionals, she also actively mentors the next generation of builders, championing inclusive growth and continuous learning in the AI space.

rahul-parwal.bio: Rahul Parwal is a Test Specialist, Speaker, Author, Ambassador, and Community Evangelist. Recipient of the Jerry Weinberg Testing Excellence Award and EuroSTAR Best Tutorial 2025. Author, course creator, and part-time YouTuber helping testers worldwide think better, test smarter, and build real-world skills through practical insights. Learn more at testingtitbits.com.

spyros-katopodis.bio: Spyros Katopodis is a Senior Lead QA Manager and Certified Scrum Master (CSM) at Zebra Technologies with experience in Cloud Services and a keen interest in Global Business. He started his career in Quality Assurance with a start-up in London focusing on Visual Search and AI Image Recognition technology (Computer Vision/Machine and Deep Learning). He holds an MPhil in Hybrid Cloud Service Security Certifications, an MEng in Computer Engineering, and an MBA. His interest in business and the global market, combined with his passion for Quality Assurance, led him to Zebra Technologies, where he leads the global Quality Assurance and Testing teams. As an ISTQB-certified Scrum Master with 10 years of experience, Spyros has developed a mindset of team agility and engagement, committed to team empowerment and to providing clear direction and support. As a proactive leader, he is highly motivated, flexible, and always adapting to the constant changes of the market and the business.

gregory-goldshteyn.bio: Gregory Goldshteyn is a QA leader with substantial experience across the IT industry, having held roles at Salesforce, Sony, and currently FOX, where he leads quality strategy within Video Engineering and Quality Assurance for high-concurrency streaming environments in which a single second of latency is unacceptable. He specializes in bridging the gap between complex backend engineering and seamless user experiences. His current focus areas include the AI revolution in QA, moving beyond traditional automation into agentic testing and GenAI to build self-healing, low-maintenance test suites, and influencing senior leadership to adopt disruptive technologies that reduce regression cycles from days to minutes. As a mabl Ambassador and frequent speaker at conferences, including Testmu Conf, Gregory shares how QA teams can leverage low-code tools to outpace traditional SDLC bottlenecks. Beyond his technical work, he leads diverse technology product teams and mentors the next generation of software developers, and he has been included in the Bristol Who's Who international registry.

mesut-durukal.bio: Mesut is a Quality Assurance Capabilities Leader with extensive experience in test automation, CI/CD transformation, and building quality into development lifecycles. In his role as a cross-squad quality leader, he focuses on scaling organizational quality capabilities across teams while continuously improving the efficiency and impact of QA practices.

gil-zilberfeld.bio: Gil Zilberfeld has been writing code and building software for over 25 years, starting with his trusty Sinclair ZX81. His career has taken him from developer to team leader and consultant, giving him a deep, holistic understanding of the software lifecycle. Today, he operates as an independent consultant and trainer under the brand TestinGil, where he helps R&D and QA professionals build better software from the inside out. Gil's core philosophy is that quality is a team sport. He is a benevolent skeptic of industry dogma, consistently challenging ineffective "best practices" in favor of pragmatic, context-driven solutions that work in the real world. He is a frequent speaker at international conferences, where he shares his expertise on topics ranging from TDD and clean code to the modern complexities of web automation. He is currently focused on creating actionable, engineering-led frameworks for ensuring the quality and long-term resilience of AI-powered systems. You can find his articles, videos, and courses at testingil.com. In his spare time, he shoots zombies for fun.

andrew-knight.bio: Andrew Knight, also known as "Pandy," is the Automation Panda. He's a software quality champion who loves to help people build better quality software. Currently, he works as the Senior Director of Product & Engineering at Cycle Labs, focusing on building an AI-forward test automation platform for enterprise systems. Previously, Pandy spent a decade as an SDET building solutions to testing problems at various tech companies. He also previously led Developer Relations and Test Automation University at Applitools. As an avid supporter of open source software, Pandy is a Playwright Ambassador as well as the creator of Boa Constrictor, the .NET Screenplay Pattern. Apart from software, Pandy spends time with his family, his French Bulldogs, and his vintage Volkswagens.

rashi-agrawal.bio: Rashi Agrawal is the Head of Agentic AI at Hinge Health, where she leads the strategic engineering of high-stakes AI systems within complex regulatory landscapes. By navigating the rigorous requirements of clinical safety, HIPAA, and global regulations, she ensures that disruptive technology remains both secure and compliant. Focused on the pioneer side of generative technology, Rashi is architecting "state-of-the-art" frameworks for Agentic AI that move beyond simple automation to solve critical member problems and drive dramatic business growth. Formerly the Head of AI at GoodLeap, she spearheaded enterprise-wide AI transformation initiatives, and earlier led engineering teams at Yahoo. A global explorer who has traveled to over 45 countries, she is an active thought leader in the Engineering Leadership and AI community, holds a Master's in Computer Science from San Jose State University, and is the founder of Women In Tech AI (WIT AI).

gurleen-kaur.bio: Gurleen Makkar is a Senior AI Software Engineer at Piramal Finance, working on Generative AI products and enterprise AI adoption. Her work focuses on creating AI-powered solutions that help teams simplify complex workflows, improve productivity, and bring business ideas closer to working software. She has worked across AI-assisted development, agentic AI workflows, internal productivity tools, and business-focused AI applications. Her interests include using AI for everyday work such as slides, documents, spreadsheets, and research, as well as applying AI to larger enterprise problems like process automation, business operations, and reimagining customer and loan journeys. At Piramal Finance, Gurleen has contributed to initiatives that help business and technology teams collaborate differently in the AI era.

keerthivasan-devaraj.bio: Keerthivasan is a Senior AI Software Engineer at Piramal Finance, working on building practical Generative AI solutions for enterprise and everyday business use. His work focuses on how AI can help teams move faster from ideas to usable software, automate repetitive workflows, and rethink how internal tools are created. He has worked across AI-assisted development, agentic workflows, business-led app creation, and AI tools for everyday productivity such as presentations, documents, spreadsheets, and research. He is especially interested in how AI can be applied beyond developer productivity to solve real business problems, improve decision-making, and reimagine enterprise workflows such as loan journeys, internal operations, and business processes. His focus is on building AI systems that are not just technically impressive, but practical, reliable, and adopted by real users.

jaydeep-chakrabarty.bio: Jaydeep Chakrabarty is Senior Director – AI at Piramal Finance, an author, award-winning technology leader, and international speaker with over 20 years of experience across AI, engineering, innovation, design, and security. He leads the creation of enterprise AI platforms and AI-native engineering capabilities, including Context Layer 2.0 and Build Your Own Tech (BYOT). BYOT was recognised as the APAC Runner-up at Gartner's 2025 Eye on Innovation Awards for Banking and Investing, and Jaydeep was subsequently invited to join the judging panel for the 2026 awards. Jaydeep is the co-author of The Value Vector: Building Scalable Generative AI-Based Applications, published by Apress — a practical guide to identifying valuable AI opportunities and taking them securely and responsibly from experimentation to enterprise scale. An early practitioner of reinforcement learning through the OpenAI Gym ecosystem between 2017 and 2019, he has also contributed to open-source initiatives including Talisman and OpenStack. He has been recognised as Global Tech Influencer of the Year 2024 and among the Most Impactful and Visionary Leaders to Watch in 2025. A regular international speaker, he speaks on agentic AI, AI-native engineering, enterprise context, responsible AI, and converting emerging technology into measurable business value.

partha-sarathi-samal.bio: Partha Samal is a Quality Engineering Leader with more than 21 years of experience in software testing. He has led test teams for media streaming platforms that serve millions of viewers across regions. His work spans test automation, performance engineering, and integration of QA practices into DevOps pipelines. Partha focuses on stable releases, strong test coverage, and fast feedback for developers. He uses AI and cloud platforms to scale test runs and spot problems earlier in the cycle. He mentors engineers on modern testing skills and builds practices that raise product quality and team ownership, and speaks at internal forums and community events on practical ways to grow QA maturity.

laveena-ramchandani.bio: Laveena Ramchandani is a passionate Test Manager who has been testing for nearly 10 years and is always seeking to learn and share. She is a community leader for data science testing and testing in general. Her entry on the digital platform has enhanced many individuals to learn a new area within testing. Laveena was a finalist for The Digital Star 2022 at the everywoman in Technology awards. She has also been featured on various podcasts and blogs, trains new testers, is a former BCS committee member, and is an international speaker.

vanessa-johnson.bio: Vanessa Johnson is an Android Engineer at The New York Times, where she works at the intersection of mobile engineering, accessibility, and developer tooling. She is passionate about making accessibility a first-class, contract-driven part of the development workflow rather than an afterthought, and builds open-source tooling that generates accessibility tests directly from GraphQL schemas.

adeel-mansoor.bio: Adeel Mansoor is a Director of Engineering focused on platform and product quality, leading teams that build reliable, data-driven services and testing infrastructure. With over a decade of experience in automation, CI/CD, and Python-based test frameworks across backend, frontend, and performance domains, he partners closely with cross-functional leaders to ship resilient products at scale. Adeel also creates practical "AI for Engineers" content on his YouTube channel, AdeelOnTech, helping developers and SDETs adopt AI-powered tooling in their day-to-day workflows.

jill-hosmer-jolley.bio: Dr. Jill Hosmer-Jolley is an educator, researcher, and speaker focused on the human side of artificial intelligence adoption. Her work explores how organizations successfully integrate AI by addressing the people, leadership, culture, and workforce changes required for technology to create meaningful impact. As a faculty member at California State University, Monterey Bay and an executive educator, Dr. Hosmer-Jolley teaches at the intersection of artificial intelligence, organizational behavior, leadership, and workforce transformation. She develops AI curriculum that prepares students and professionals to work effectively in a future where humans and intelligent systems collaborate. Her current research focuses on human-centered AI adoption, neurodiversity, organizational readiness, and the changing relationship between humans and technology. She examines why technically successful AI initiatives often struggle during implementation and how organizations can build trust, redesign workflows, and create environments where both people and AI systems thrive. Dr. Hosmer-Jolley brings a practical, applied perspective to AI conversations by bridging academic research and real-world business challenges. Her message emphasizes that the future of AI will not be determined by technology alone — it will depend on how effectively humans learn to lead, adapt, and partner with intelligent systems.

rushabh-mehta.bio: Rushabh Mehta is a Staff Software Engineer at Meta with 12 years of experience building AI/ML infrastructure at billion-user scale. He currently leads development of environments to train and evaluate LLMs for agentic and tool-use capabilities, including onboarding evaluation benchmarks for rigorous model assessment. He built a Distributed Training Framework adopted by 80+ models, with a focus on training reliability — his cross-org initiatives have driven significant cost savings through GPU optimization and reduced idle time. Previously at Amazon, Rushabh led teams building Alexa's personalization platform and Prime Video's digital rights infrastructure. His backend work spans security, trust, and privacy across voice AI, payments, and streaming domains. Rushabh holds a Master's in Computer Science from Cornell University.

joe-colantonio.bio: Joe Colantonio has over 25 years of experience in software automation testing and is the founder of Test Guild – a dedicated independent resource for actionable and real-world technical advice from industry experts (blog, video tutorials, podcasts, and online conferences) to help improve your DevOps automation, performance, and security testing efforts. He is the host of the longest-running podcast on automation testing. He has interviewed over 500 industry leaders and hosted over 600 hours of live online events for some of the biggest companies in the software testing space. Joe's company, Test Guild, also provides services to software companies to help them reach a community of highly engaged, growth-oriented, and ambitious audiences of 27k+ software testing professionals.

jim-trentadue.bio: Jim Trentadue has more than two decades of experience as a director/manager in the software testing field. In his various roles in his testing career, Jim has focused on test execution, automation, management, environment management, standards deployment, and test tool implementation. In the area of offshore testing, Jim has worked with multiple large firms to develop and coordinate cohesive relationships. As a guest speaker at the University of South Florida’s software testing class, Jim mentors students on the testing industry and trends for establishing future job searches and continued training.

nilesh-dalvi.bio: Nilesh is an engineering leader at Glean with more than 18 years of experience spanning machine learning, data, and large-scale systems. He previously co-founded Trooly, which was acquired by Airbnb, where he later led the Trust Infrastructure group, and has also served as CTO of Fiddler AI. Nilesh holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of Washington and a B.Tech from IIT Bombay, and is widely recognized for his work advancing trustworthy AI, with numerous patents, publications, and industry awards.

lisa-dieker.role: Williamson Family Distinguished Professor in Special Education
lisa-dieker.bio: Dr. Lisa Dieker is the Williamson Family Distinguished Professor of Special Education at the University of Kansas (KU), the #1 nationally ranked program, where she directs the FLITE (Flexible Learning through Innovations in Technology and Education) Center. Dr. Dieker's research focuses on harnessing the power of teachers working across a variety of settings, with a focus on teacher education, special education, and innovative uses of technology. Before KU, she was a Pegasus Professor at the University of Central Florida, serving as the Lockheed Martin Eminent Scholar and advising over 100 Ph.D. students. She has managed over 75 grants amounting to more than $30M. She has provided over 150 keynotes, produced 12 books and over 100 articles and chapters, and served as an editor or associate editor for five journals in the field. She holds six patents in simulation and education.

mathias-strziga.bio: Mathias Strziga is a QA veteran and a recognized pioneer in Mobile Testing within leading agencies. With over 15 years of experience across Quality Assurance, IT Operations, and Information Security, he has delivered high-impact testing strategies for global giants and automotive powerhouses, including BMW, Audi, Cariad, Vorwerk, Rocket Internet, and the Aldi Group. As a strategic leader, Mathias specializes in bridging the gap between rigorous engineering and watertight security. He expertly manages ISO 27001 and TISAX systems, guiding organizations through complex audits, risk management, and technical IT governance. Always looking ahead, Mathias is currently driving the QA AI Transformation within the Artificial Intelligence Development Lifecycle (AIDLC). He acts as a trusted advisor to clients worldwide, helping them navigate Information Security and successfully implement "Quality First" organizational transformations.

pramod-yadav.bio: Pramod Yadav is a seasoned test automation expert with extensive experience in designing and scaling end-to-end automation frameworks across both enterprise and startup environments. As a Test Engineering Manager at ABN AMRO Clearing, he combines deep technical acumen with a strong leadership ethos, mentoring teams, fostering a culture of continuous learning, and delivering robust quality solutions. With a rare blend of hands-on engineering and strategic oversight, Pramod thrives as both a team player and an individual contributor. His colleagues recognize him as a natural leader, dedicated mentor, and someone who brings out the best in others. Beyond his professional role, Pramod is a passionate tech creator and educator. He actively shares his learnings through his YouTube channel and contributes to the open-source community with tools like RunWright, agentic-semver, RestPro, Zero, Slurp, and Happium, which focus on CICD, API, Web, and Mobile automation.

lisha-rakesh.role: Sr. Director - Head of Insurance Testing
lisha-rakesh.bio: With 20+ years in the IT industry, Lisha specializes in consulting, solutioning, and delivering complex transformation programs across global markets. Currently leading the Financial Services North America Insurance Testing portfolio at Capgemini, Lisha drives strategic growth and testing innovation, with a focus on efficiency and optimization within the customer landscape. Certified in Kanban, SAFe, and Six Sigma, Lisha brings deep Agile expertise and has coached enterprises through successful transitions from waterfall to Agile methodologies.

deepak-kamboj.bio: Deepak Kamboj is a senior software engineer and AI solution architect at Microsoft with over 25 years of experience in enterprise software, AI-powered automation, and developer productivity. He specializes in agentic workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, multi-agent systems, and generative AI applications, delivering measurable organizational value. At Microsoft, Deepak has helped multiple teams adopt modern Playwright-based test automation and has built AI-driven test generation and self-healing pipelines to improve engineering efficiency. He is a Copilot Champion, a Microsoft Hackathon participant and advisor, and a recognized accessibility champion. Deepak holds a B.Tech. in computer science and engineering and is an active voice in the developer community through his LinkedIn newsletter AI Weekly, his GitHub projects, and speaking engagements focused on practical AI, automation at scale, and developer experience.

nishant-gupta.bio: Nishant Gupta is a Staff Software Engineer at Meta, where he builds large-scale AI infrastructure and distributed systems powering next-generation agentic AI platforms. His work spans distributed computing, inference infrastructure, resource scheduling, production evaluation systems, and reliable AI agents. Prior to his current role, Nishant led infrastructure initiatives managing elastic compute capacity across millions of servers, improving utilization while maintaining strict reliability and performance objectives. His recent work focuses on the operational challenges of deploying AI agents in production, including evaluation frameworks, orchestration, observability, cost optimization, and deterministic infrastructure for non-deterministic AI systems. Nishant is an active researcher with multiple peer-reviewed publications in distributed systems and artificial intelligence, including work on large-scale resource optimization and AI-driven infrastructure. He is also an international conference speaker, having presented at events including AI Engineer World's Fair, DeveloperWeek, IEEE conferences, and other global AI and software engineering conferences. His talks focus on operating agentic AI systems, production evaluation pipelines, distributed inference, and scalable AI infrastructure. Nishant is passionate about bridging cutting-edge AI research with real-world production systems, helping organizations build reliable, scalable, and efficient AI platforms that operate safely at global scale.

rakesh-sukla.role: Director of Engineering - Platform and Quality Engineering
rakesh-sukla.bio: Rakesh Sukla is an accomplished engineering leader and domain expert in Quality Automation, Cloud-Orchestrated CI/CD, and Developer Productivity, with a proven record of driving innovation at scale. He has consistently served as a foundational engineer across organizations, architecting enterprise-grade automation platforms and orchestrating pipelines from the ground up. He is recognized for improving software quality, accelerating release velocity, and reducing operational costs by building high-impact systems and scaling high-performing global teams.

stephan-mousset.role: Product Manager - Global Performance and Resilience Engineering Platform
stephan-mousset.bio: Stephan Mousset is Product Manager by job title and Reliability Translator by necessity. He spends his time helping teams navigate the complicated relationship between performance testing, observability, resilience, and reality. As the driving force behind ING's global Performance & Resilience Engineering platform, Stormbreaker, he works to ensure that performance testing produces confidence rather than dashboards nobody reads. As a long-time reliability advocate and community builder, Stephan believes that systems fail in interesting ways, people are usually doing their best, and good engineering starts with understanding how technology and humans work together. His unofficial mission is reducing cognitive load, increasing reliability, and gently convincing teams that production feedback is a feature, not an afterthought. Fortunately, the platform he manages is easier to reason about than humans.

sai-krishna.bio: Sai Krishna is the Director of Engineering at TestMu AI. He is an active contributor to Appium and a member of the Appium organization, with deep involvement in the open-source community. He is passionate about innovative thinking and regularly contributes to open-source technologies. In addition to his technical pursuits, Sai is a blogger, community builder, mentor, international speaker, and conference organizer.

srinivasan-sekar.bio: Srinivasan Sekar is a Director of Engineering at TestMu AI. He loves contributing to Open Source. He is an Appium Member and Contributor to various open-source repositories like Selenium, Webdriver.io, taiko, etc. He worked extensively on testing various Microservices, Event-Driven Apps, and Mobile and Web Applications. He specializes in building automation frameworks. He has spoken at various conferences including SeleniumConf, AppiumConf, AgileIndia, XConf Singapore, Quest4Quality, BelgradeTestConf, and FOSDEM.

shafik-quoraishee.bio: Shafik Quoraishee is a Staff Game Engineer at The New York Times, where he works on integrating and developing highly popular games like The New York Times Crossword, Wordle, and Connections. Bringing deep expertise in mobile infrastructure and machine learning, he focuses on the intersection of AI, game development, and user accessibility, having previously held engineering roles at the National Basketball Association (NBA) and Business Insider. An avid AI practitioner and industry speaker, he frequently presents at global tech conferences on topics such as multimodal machine learning, neural networks, and the architectural differences between human and artificial general intelligence.

neelmani-verma.bio: Neelmani Verma is an Industry Principal at Infosys, and head of the Consulting group at Infosys Quality Engineering, a leader who has spent 22 years turning complex, high-stakes problems into competitive advantages for global organizations. Today, she is at the forefront of the generative AI revolution, embedding AI-driven innovation directly into her clients' most pressing challenges. Her ability to bridge technical depth with business impact has made her a trusted advisor for organizations navigating the next frontier of enterprise transformation.

magnus-hillestad.bio: Magnus K. Hillestad is the CEO and Co-founder of Sanity.

sobhitha-neelanath.bio: Sobhitha is an accomplished industry leader with diverse technology and domain expertise of 2 decades across companies like Wipro, McAfee, EMC and Dell. In her current role at Salesforce, she heads the quality engineering team for Agentforce Service India. She is an IEEE WIE Industry Expert and serves on the Advisory Committee for GHCI. She contributes actively to multiple technical communities and mentoring initiatives for technology professionals and students. As a Google Women Techmakers Ambassador, she has delivered multiple sessions for global audiences. A recipient of the Salesforce Women Of Impact Award 2026, her contributions towards quality were recently recognised with the Quality Leadership Award by World Quality Congress. Her Mantra for life is "Explore, Believe, Achieve".

lazar-jovanovic.bio: Lazar is the first Vibe Coding Engineer hired at Lovable, and so far he's created over 500 production-ready apps, with his primary area of expertise being the creation of internal tooling for the GTM team at Lovable.

amanda-martin.bio: Amanda leads DevRel at Vapi, where she helps developers build great Voice AI agents. She brings over 10 years of experience, starting as a developer before moving into developer relations. A creative problem solver, she's currently focused on agent experience and how it shapes both the developers building agents and the agents themselves. When she's not deep in agent sessions, you can find her exploring SF, playing with her dogs, cycling, reading, or trying a new recipe.

jyotheeswara-gottam.bio: Jyotheeswara Gottam is a technology professional specializing in software quality engineering and modern testing practices with 15+ years experience. With a strong focus on innovation in test automation, Jyotheeswara has a keen interest in leveraging emerging technologies such as Generative AI, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation to improve software reliability and reduce operational costs. Currently working at Walmart, Jyotheeswara contributes to building scalable and efficient testing solutions for complex enterprise systems. Their work emphasizes the adoption of data-driven and AI-powered approaches to enhance test coverage, accelerate delivery cycles, and improve overall product quality. Jyotheeswara is particularly passionate about transforming traditional QA processes into intelligent, adaptive systems and actively explores advancements in self-healing automation and risk-based testing strategies. Through research and practical implementation, they aim to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI capabilities and real-world software engineering challenges.

pooja-oza.bio: Pooja is a Senior QA/SDET Engineer at Walt Disney Studios, leading a team of QA/SDET engineers with 13+ years of experience in test automation and quality engineering. Her current focus is helping her team adopt AI to make quality engineering faster and more efficient from test authoring to execution. She's based in Redmond.

walter-zimerman.bio: Walter Zimerman is a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with extensive experience designing and validating large-scale, distributed systems. His work focuses on quality engineering, test architecture, and trust at scale, particularly in environments where automation, AI, and complex decision-making intersect. Over the years, Walter has worked on high-impact systems where correctness, reliability, and user trust are critical, helping teams move beyond traditional pass/fail testing toward more resilient and evaluative quality practices. He has deep experience with automation frameworks, system-level testing, and designing guardrails for highly dynamic, data-driven systems. Walter explores how quality engineering must evolve when systems no longer simply execute instructions but generate answers users are expected to trust. Walter regularly speaks with engineers and quality leaders about scaling quality responsibly in modern systems, advocating for trust as a first-class architectural concern rather than a byproduct of automation.

harinee-muralinath.bio: Harinee Muralinath is a Director and Business Information Security Officer at Thoughtworks, leading information security for India and the Middle East, as well as security for the company's AI platform initiatives. She has previously served as Quality Analyst, Head of Capabilities, Head of Security for India and Global Security Community Lead. She is the co-author of The Value Vector: Building Scalable Generative AI-Based Applications and a technical reviewer of books on MCP and MCP security. A multiple women in corporate awards recipient, including recognition for innovation, Harinee is passionate about mentoring women and young technologists, contributing to open source, writing and sharing knowledge with the wider technology community. She regularly speaks at national and international conferences on AI security, software quality and secure engineering. Her published work includes perspectives on DevSecOps, cybersecurity, responsible AI and building security into software-delivery culture.

wessel-braakman.bio: Wessel is a test automation specialist with over 12.5 years of experience helping development teams deliver high-quality software. Throughout his career, he has worked closely with developers of many different personalities and communication styles. Drawing on real-world project experience, he shares practical techniques for adapting your approach to different types of developers, building stronger collaboration, and making quality discussions more effective.

jan-schnyder.bio: Jan Schnyder is a co-founder of nunu.ai, a swiss YC startup building AI agents to play and test video games. He was previously a competitive gamer and has a background in machine learning from ETH Zurich. He now spends his time between Zurich and San Francisco, working at the intersection of AI, games and robotics.

nicolas-muntwyler.bio: Nicolas Muntwyler is a co-founder of nunu.ai, a swiss YC startup building AI agents to play and test video games. He has a background in machine learning from ETH Zurich and is currently leading the product side of nunu.

justin-yuan.bio: Justin Yuan is a Partner and founding member of TIRTA Ventures, based in New York. Justin brings over a decade of investing experience across private and public markets. Prior to TIRTA, he led Tencent's North America games investment team. Earlier in his career, he was a public equity investor at Citadel focusing on global internet and interactive entertainment, and a private equity investor at Fortress Investment Group. He began his career in investment banking at Citigroup in Hong Kong.

francesca-lazzeri.bio: Francesca Lazzeri, Ph.D., is Principal Group Director of Data and Applied AI Science at Microsoft, where she leads a global team of applied scientists and AI engineers building production LLM copilots and autonomous agents. She owns the measurement, evaluation, experimentation, and fine-tuning stack behind the AI agentic transformation across Microsoft's commercial business. Francesca holds a Ph.D. in Economics and Technology Innovation from Sant'Anna School of Advanced Studies (Italy) and, before joining Microsoft, she was a Research Fellow at Harvard University (Cambridge, MA). She is an Adjunct Professor in Python for Machine Learning at Columbia University, an AI Advisor to MIT Breakthrough Tech AI, the author of multiple books on machine learning and AI governance, and a named inventor on granted patents in natural language querying and applied machine learning.

kishor-wikhe.role: Executive Vice President | Head, Sogeti India
kishor-wikhe.bio: Kishor Wikhe is the Head of Sogeti India since April 2024, a key position within the Capgemini Group, and brings more than 33 years of experience across BFSI, Business Services, and Enterprise Technology. In his current role, he oversees P&L, drives strategic initiatives to boost business performance, futureproofs portfolios, and builds high-performing delivery teams to foster innovation and thought leadership across Sogeti India.

mhahesh-muraleedhara.role: Head of Quality Intelligence for North America
mhahesh-muraleedhara.bio: Mhahesh Muraleedhara is the Head of Quality Intelligence for North America at Zensar Technologies, where he leads enterprise quality strategy, AI-led transformation, solution innovation, and delivery governance for global organizations. Known as the “QE Alchemist,” Mhahesh is passionate about transforming traditional Quality Engineering into an intelligent, outcome-driven discipline. His work focuses on applying Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, predictive intelligence, and autonomous testing to improve engineering productivity, accelerate releases, and strengthen business assurance. An award-winning technology leader, he has been recognized with the TestMu AI Quality Engineering Catalyst Award, Zensar’s Innovator of the Year Award, the Tricentis India Community Award, and inclusion in Marquis Who’s Who for Excellence in Engineering. Mhahesh is also a keynote speaker, panelist, and author who regularly shares strong industry perspectives on Quality Intelligence, AI-led engineering, autonomous testing, and responsible AI adoption.

ojus-save.bio: Ojus Save is a Developer Relations Engineer at Render, where he helps developers take applications from code to production. He has spent nearly a decade in developer-facing roles at Render, Zoom, Google, and Neura, working across engineering, product, technical education, and community. Much of his career has focused on taking complex platform capabilities and making them useful through practical examples and direct developer feedback. His current work focuses on cloud platforms and AI infrastructure.

sumit-shatwara.bio: Sumit Shatwara is a Forward Deployed Engineer at Cognition, based in India, where he works with global system integrators and enterprise customers to bring agentic software engineering and agentic security into real production environments. Sumit's path into this space started with hands-on code. Nearly 8 years ago, he was a Python developer writing plugins line by line. Since then, he has spent his career learning the layers that modern software depends on, including cloud infrastructure, databases, application modernization, DevSecOps, and cybersecurity, through roles at Wiz, Neo4j, Redis, and Red Hat. That foundation now shapes how he thinks about agentic AI: not as a replacement for engineering discipline, but as its next evolution. At Cognition, Sumit works directly with developer teams inside large GSIs and large customers, helping them adopt autonomous software engineers like Devin to move beyond code assistance into genuine end-to-end software delivery. His work sits at the intersection of developer experience, enterprise scale, and the practical realities of shipping agentic systems into production, not just demos. He is based in Mumbai and has spent his career translating deep technical work into outcomes that matter for enterprise teams building at scale.

john-liang.bio: John Liang is a Senior Director of Software Engineering at Salesforce, where he has spent 18 years helping build and scale enterprise software. He currently leads Q3 engineering for Service Cloud, with a focus on quality engineering and testing strategy. His work centers on the shift from static to dynamic testing methodologies in the age of agentic enterprise software — helping teams rethink quality practices as AI-driven systems become core to how software is built and validated. John is passionate about AI quality, testing innovation, and quality leadership, and regularly partners with engineering teams to raise the bar on how quality is measured and delivered at scale. At TestMu, he'll share how Salesforce has evolved its testing approach to keep pace with agentic AI systems.

mallika-fernandes.bio: Mallika Fernandes is an IT leader with 27 years of industry experience and extensive expertise in driving innovation, building industry-trending tools, and leading transformational programs. She leads the Quality Engineering Capability at Accenture. She holds 23 patents, and her 'AI in testing' research work is published by MIT in their book "Why Humans Matter More Than Ever (Digital Future of Management)".

rahul-shetty.bio: Rahul Shetty is a globally recognized QA instructor, international speaker, and the founder of Rahul Shetty Academy. With over 15 years of hands-on experience in software testing, he has trained more than 1 million QA professionals across 195 countries through his best-selling Udemy courses on Selenium, Playwright, AI Testing, Cypress, Appium, Postman, and more. He also leads multiple QA-focused ventures, including QA Summit, a high-impact offline conference and mentorship platform, and RS TekSolutions, his software consulting firm. Across all his initiatives, Rahul's mission is clear: to simplify test automation and empower testers to accelerate their careers with real-world skills, confidence, and mentorship. Rahul's teaching style blends deep technical knowledge with an understanding of the QA mindset. He's known for helping testers transition from manual to automation and beyond, especially those who struggle to find structured guidance. Through his courses, conferences, and mentorship, he's created a global community of testers who are not just learning tools, but transforming into future-ready automation professionals.

prince-verma.bio: Prince Verma is VP of Engineering at TestMu AI, where he has led the build-out of real-device testing, scaled desktop testing capabilities, and now drives the development of KaneAI, an AI-native assistant reshaping QA workflows. With a career that blends deep technical execution and team leadership, Prince thrives on turning complex engineering challenges into elegant, scalable solutions.

athresh-guruprakash.bio: Athresh is a technology leader with over 18 years of experience across software engineering and applied AI/ML systems, currently leading engineering teams at Equifax within financial services risk technology. Over his career he has built and led diverse, cross-functional engineering organizations — owning delivery, technical direction, and team growth — with a strong personal focus on mentoring engineers at every career stage, from early-career developers to senior individual contributors. His technical interests sit at the intersection of large language model evaluation, AI-augmented engineering practices, and responsible AI deployment in regulated industries. Beyond his day-to-day role, Athresh authors published research spanning LLM reliability, applied ML, and large-scale systems architecture, and contributes to Tech with AG, a learning forum that makes modern AI concepts accessible to students and early-career technologists.

monika-sharma.bio: Monika Sharma is a quality-driven software engineer with over a decade of experience architecting and executing comprehensive testing strategies across the software lifecycle. Her functional testing expertise spans UI, API, and human-to-agent interaction testing, complemented by deep cross-functional proficiency in performance and infrastructure testing. This breadth allows her to assess quality holistically — from the user-facing surface to the systems that support it beneath. A self-described quality enthusiast, Monika approaches testing not as a checkpoint but as a discipline, drawing on diverse methodologies to uncover risk and elevate product reliability. Her versatility across testing domains reflects a broader commitment to engineering excellence, one grounded in curiosity, rigor, and an appreciation for the craft in all its forms.

chinmaya-kothari.role: Director - Quality Engineering and AI CoE
chinmaya-kothari.bio: Chinmaya Kothari is an AI and Quality Engineering leader with over 15 years of experience helping global enterprises modernize software engineering through quality, automation and emerging technologies. He specializes in applying quality engineering principles to enterprise AI, enabling organizations to build AI systems that are not only intelligent but also reliable, secure, and trustworthy. At QualiZeal, Chinmaya has been instrumental in shaping the company's AI strategy, driving initiatives across AI-powered Quality Engineering, AI Assurance and Enterprise AI Engineering. His work focuses on the practical challenges organizations face when deploying GenAI applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and AI agents in production — ranging from evaluation and governance to security, observability and continuous assurance. Chinmaya has worked with clients across highly regulated industries to help them adopt AI responsibly while accelerating engineering outcomes. He has contributed to AI engineering methodologies, AI security frameworks and governance models aligned with emerging standards such as ISO/IEC 42001. Known for combining quality engineering depth with practical insights, Chinmaya enjoys translating complex AI concepts into actionable strategies for quality engineering teams and technology leaders. His sessions are grounded in real-world implementation experience and focus on helping practitioners prepare for the next evolution of Quality Engineering in the era of intelligent software.

anubhav-singhmaar.bio: Anubhav Singhmaar is a Product Manager at TestMu AI, working on the platform's AI-native testing products. He focuses on making AI test agents prove their claims: sealed evidence records, requirement-to-test traceability, and honest benchmarks. His session covers evidence-based QA and the openly published .evidence format.

maryia-tuleika.bio: Maryia is a Quality Engineering Leader who leads teams, creates testing strategies, drives education programs and actively contributes to the testing community. As a mentor, speaker and podcast host, she helps new test professionals build their skills and confidence. With experience spanning multiple industries, she brings a broad perspective on testing and risk-based decision-making. She believes that great testing brings both technical excellence and knowing what to prioritize, think critically and enjoy the process. Maryia takes an active role in conferences around the globe. In recent years, she has spoken at several international events, has been a program chair, program committee and review member. She is a podcast host and a co-founder of Beyond Quality community of practice.

sachin-sharma.bio: Sachin Sharma is one of the Co-founders of The Test Chat, one of the fastest-growing software testing communities, connecting thousands of quality engineering professionals through learning, collaboration, and knowledge sharing. Over the years, he has actively contributed as an ambassador to multiple testing communities and has had the privilege of speaking at several national and international conferences. One of the most rewarding parts of this journey has been building meaningful relationships with passionate testers, engineering leaders, and community builders across the globe. Professionally, Sachin currently works as a Quality Engineering Leader at adidas, where he focuses on driving quality transformation through scalable engineering practices, strategic testing, and continuous improvement. Over the past few years, his curiosity has evolved beyond automation and AI adoption to a much bigger question: how can we fundamentally improve the way engineers think? While Artificial Intelligence is rapidly transforming software engineering, Sachin believes its greatest value lies not in replacing human thinking, but in amplifying it. His work explores how AI can help engineers observe better, analyze deeper, collaborate smarter, and ultimately make better engineering decisions. His sessions blend storytelling, psychology, engineering principles, practical innovation, and thought-provoking analogies to challenge conventional thinking. Whether he speaks about AI, leadership, quality engineering, or efficiency, the destination is always the same: helping engineers think differently before they build differently. Sachin strongly believes that the future of engineering won't belong to the teams that automate the most. It will belong to the teams that think the best.

vibhor-rastogi.bio: Vibhor is a growth and private equity investor in enterprise software, including data/AI/ML. Vibhor's prior investing experience includes General Partner at SymphonyAI, a $1B mid-market AI focused private equity fund, and Investment Director at Intel Capital, Intel's global VC group investing $500M-$700M per year in startups globally. Vibhor has experience originating, structuring, and executing deals in North America, Europe, and Asia (China and India), and has investing experience in a variety of sectors. His exits include: iZettle (Fintech, acquired for $2.2B by Paypal); Venafi (cybersecurity, acquired for $1.2B by Thoma Bravo); Cloudgenix (SD-WAN, acquired by Palo Alto Networks for $460M); EazyTec (cloud computing and IoT in China, $1B IPO on the Shanghai stock exchange); Basis (smartwatch, acquired by Intel); Paxata (self-service data prep for big data and ML workloads, acquired by DataRobot); CareCloud (SaaS/digital health, acquired by Nasdaq: MTBC); and TOA (mobile field service, acquired by Oracle). During his investing career, Vibhor has served on multiple boards and has extensive corporate governance experience. Vibhor has also served as interim CEO/COO of portfolio companies and greatly enjoys helping companies with their growth strategy, sales strategy and operational execution of business plans. Prior to his investing career, he was a management and technology consultant at Deloitte. Vibhor has an MBA with High Honors from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, where he won the Student Management Investment Fund scholarship, and an undergraduate degree in Civil Engineering from IIT Kanpur, where he won the Dean's Award for academic excellence. Outside of investing, he enjoys hiking, running, and non-fiction reading.

sunita-mccoy.bio: Sunita McCoy is Director of Quality Engineering at Pizza Hut, where the SLA is a hungry family and the ultimate load test is Super Bowl Sunday. If the app works when America orders pizza all at once, her team did its job. Over 20+ years at Fortune 100 enterprises like Foot Locker, Advance Auto Parts, and MetLife, she's built global quality organizations of over 350 engineers supporting over 5000 stores and restaurants and turned AI testing from shiny demo into daily driver: 75% faster incident detection, 30% less manual test design, and self-healing automation that (mostly) behaves itself. But ask Sunita what she's proudest of, and it won't be the metrics. She's a passionate force multiplier who empowers people to uncover their best selves and unleash their superpowers - mentoring high-performing teams that run autonomously, deliver outcomes, and elevate the bottom line. A returning TestMu speaker and fierce advocate for women in tech and AI, Sunita believes the best quality engineers ask the questions nobody else will and that every great release, like every great pizza, comes down to what happens under heat.

raghavendra-prasad-mg.role: Head Of Sub Practice | AI/GenAI Solution Building for Quality Engineering
raghavendra-prasad-mg.bio: Raghavendra Prasad MG leads AI/GenAI Solution Building for Quality Engineering at Wipro, helping enterprises accelerate innovation, improve quality, and deliver measurable business outcomes through Agentic AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and governance-driven transformation. He collaborates with clients, tools & technology partners to modernize quality engineering, optimize delivery efficiency, enable responsible AI adoption, and build scalable enterprise-ready solutions.

dror-avrilingi.role: Amdocs Studios CTO & Head of Quality Engineering Studio
dror-avrilingi.bio: Dror Avrilingi brings more than 25 years of QE leadership to his role as CTO of Amdocs Studios and Head of its Quality Engineering Studio. Dror spearheads development of Amdocs Studios' Agentic Framework, overseeing the integration of AI across its full spectrum, from predictive models to advanced agentic systems. Previously, as Head of Amdocs Quality Engineering International, he led global QE strategy and oversaw significant organizational growth. A longstanding advocate for advancing QE beyond traditional testing models, Dror founded the NextGen QE Consortium to convene industry leaders around emerging trends shaping the future of quality. His focus today is on building governance-driven, AI-enabled quality frameworks that enable enterprises to confidently scale into the agentic era.

preetham-sunilkumar.bio: Preetham Sunilkumar serves as Vice President and Software Development Manager at LPL Financial, leading strategic initiatives in platform modernization, software development, quality engineering and software delivery. He specializes in transforming software development organizations through scalable automation frameworks, AI-powered quality solutions, and modern DevOps practices. With a strong track record of driving engineering excellence in complex enterprise environments, Preetham focuses on enabling faster, more reliable software delivery while fostering innovation and continuous improvement across teams.

trincy-thomas.bio: Trincy Thomas is a senior Quality Engineering leader at Gen Digital, with over 20 years of experience across fintech, BFSI, and technology. She specializes in transforming QA into a strategic engineering function through automation, data quality, CI/CD, and scalable quality practices — with deep experience navigating the data integrity, cross-system consistency, compliance, security, and change-risk challenges of regulated financial environments.

ankur-agarwal.bio: Ankur Agarwal is a Quality Engineering leader with extensive experience driving quality transformation, AI-driven testing, and enterprise test automation. He leads Quality Engineering for multiple AI-enabled product portfolios and manages high-performing global QA teams. He has spearheaded innovative solutions such as AI-driven automation platforms, visual testing frameworks, self-healing automation, and intelligent quality evaluation services, delivering significant improvements in automation efficiency, test coverage, and release quality. As a strong advocate for modern quality practices, Ankur collaborates closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to embed quality throughout the SDLC and drive innovation at scale.

nagarjun-adikesavan.role: AI & Automation Engineering Lead, Quality and Reliability Engineering
nagarjun-adikesavan.bio: Nagarjun Adikesavan is an AI & Automation Engineering Leader with extensive experience driving enterprise-scale quality, reliability, and intelligent automation initiatives in the healthcare industry. He leads the strategy and adoption of AI-powered engineering solutions, focusing on software quality, test automation, platform engineering, and responsible AI implementation. Nagarjun has been instrumental in advancing next-generation quality engineering capabilities, including agentic AI, intelligent test automation, knowledge-driven engineering, and enterprise confidence platforms that help organizations improve software reliability while meeting stringent regulatory and compliance requirements. He is passionate about leveraging AI to accelerate software delivery, enhance developer productivity, and strengthen trust through governance, validation, and measurable quality outcomes.

khimanand-upreti.role: Managing Director and Head of AI in Run BU
khimanand-upreti.bio: Khimanand Upreti is Managing Director and Global Head of the "AI in Run" Business Unit at Nagarro, where he has been leading and driving the strategy for the testing business unit. His passion in testing is focused on new digitalization topics, AI, inclusiveness, sustainability, and many emerging technologies.

chad-ullman.bio: Chad is a seasoned professional with almost 30 years of experience in IT. In that time, he's run the gamut from development to DevOps to QA and ended up specializing in Test Automation. As manager of Delta Dental's QE Center of Excellence, Chad is focused on developing and maintaining the fundamental standards and platforms that empower Delta's development teams to deliver to the highest standards of quality, whether that's through test management practices, functional test automation, or non-functional testing.

ali-karnib.bio: Ali Karnib is Head of Quality Engineering at Gallup and an engineering leader with over a decade of experience across software delivery, quality engineering, automation, architecture, and DevOps. He led the transformation of the QA function into a modern quality engineering practice, implementing shift-left principles and embedding quality throughout product development rather than treating it as a final checkpoint. His work spans scalable automation across UI, APIs, and event-driven systems, CI/CD pipelines, and shaping architectural decisions that enable reliable systems and efficient delivery. Ali is passionate about building strong teams, fostering shared ownership, and continuously improving how software is engineered and delivered. He is currently advancing quality engineering for the AI era, modernizing engineering toolchains and developing practical approaches to scaling quality, testing infrastructure, and engineering practices for agentic and non-deterministic systems.

eshwar-pastapur.bio: Eshwar G. Pastapur is an award-winning CIO, technologist, entrepreneur, and speaker with more than 30 years of global experience leading AI, data, and digital transformation across the insurance industry. A two-time CIO 100 Award winner and 2023 Michigan CIO of the Year, he has delivered more than $100 million in business value through modernization and automation. Today, as Founder and CEO of SYMPLYPHY.AI, he helps organizations turn AI from hype into practical business outcomes, with a mission to make emerging technology understandable and accessible from boardrooms to classrooms.

brianna-elsass.bio: Brianna Elsass is an enterprise digital transformation leader and the EVP & Chief Digital Officer at Associated Bank. With deep experience across major financial institutions, she has led award-winning digital, omni-channel, and AI-enabled customer experience programs, integrated multibillion-dollar acquisitions, and modernized core platforms to position organizations for future growth. Known for her ability to simplify complexity and build trusted, high-performing teams, Brianna blends bespoke technology innovation with strategic vendor ecosystems to deliver scalable, customer-centric solutions. She is a former Vice Chair of the Advisory Board for The Washington Center and a frequent industry speaker on digital banking, responsible AI, and enterprise transformation. She brings a forward-leaning perspective on how financial institutions can innovate with clarity, confidence, and discipline — while keeping the customer at the heart of every decision.

brian-corkery.role: Managing Director - Banking and Financial Service

anand-moorthy.bio: Global executive and board advisor with 30+ years of leadership experience in strategic planning, sales, operations, and P&L management. Built and led major testing and consulting practices at Capgemini, Hexaware, and Wipro, growing multi-million-dollar portfolios and advising CIOs on enterprise technology strategy. Deep experience developing new markets, including significant growth across Mexico and Brazil, complemented by an entrepreneurial foundation in manufacturing and process engineering.

deepshikha.bio: Deepshikha leads Nagarro's AI in Testing practice and brings over 13 years of experience at the intersection of software quality and emerging technologies. She specializes in designing AI-driven testing strategies that enhance reliability, accelerate delivery, and help organizations build systems that are not only efficient but also trustworthy and resilient when it matters most.

nagendra-bs.role: Senior Vice President - DevOps, SRE & Digital Assurance
nagendra-bs.bio: Nagendra BS is a transformation-focused technology executive with 25+ years of experience building and scaling global Quality Engineering, DevOps, SRE, and AI-enabled enterprise transformation organizations across Financial Services, Telecom, Retail, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Travel, and Hi-Tech industries. He has a proven track record of establishing scalable operating models, governing large distributed delivery organizations, driving AI-led quality transformation, and building multi-hundred-million-dollar business portfolios. He currently leads Hexaware's global Quality Engineering, DevOps, and SRE business with responsibility across transformation strategy, delivery governance, workforce scaling, capability development, GTM execution, strategic alliances, and enterprise customer success.

jeba-abraham.bio: Jeba Abraham is an industry thought leader focused on advancing the future of Quality Engineering in an AI-first world. He helps enterprises adopt and scale Agentic AI across software delivery, driving new approaches to quality, automation, and engineering effectiveness. As one of the lead authors of the World Quality Report, Jeba brings a practitioner's perspective on how organizations can transform software quality into a catalyst for innovation, speed, and business value.

richa-agrawal.bio: Richa Agrawal is a Global Quality Engineering and Transformation leader with 25+ years of experience across software engineering, quality assurance, automation, and enterprise transformation. As Associate Vice President & Global Head of Quality Engineering at GlobalLogic, she drives the evolution from traditional QA to AI-first Quality Engineering, with a focus on AI/GenAI validation, automation-led transformation, continuous testing, and quality engineering at enterprise scale. Richa is also an inventor and patent holder of TestOptimizer (US20150234734A1), a system and method for electronic-document-based automated software testing, reflecting her long-standing focus on simplifying and transforming software testing through technology. Her current work explores some of the most critical challenges in AI-driven quality engineering, including validation of non-deterministic outputs, reliability, prompt testing, AI-assisted automation, and risk-aware enterprise adoption. She holds a B.E. in Computer Science, a Post Graduate Program in AI & ML from the University of Texas at Austin, and has completed the ISB CTO Program. She has received multiple recognitions for technology innovation, AI in testing, and women in technology.

nipam-desai.role: Engineering Manager for Quality, Environment & Release
nipam-desai.bio: Nipam Desai is an Engineering Manager for Quality, Environment & Release at a leading global fashion retailer, where he leads enterprise Quality Engineering, Release Management, Environment Strategy, and Engineering Excellence initiatives. With more than 18 years of experience across retail, financial services, payments, and digital transformation, he has built and scaled Quality Engineering organisations, modernised testing practices, and delivered large-scale business-critical transformation programmes. Throughout his career, Nipam has progressed from leading global QA teams to heading enterprise Quality Assurance functions, with responsibility for quality strategy, automation, release governance, vendor management, and engineering transformation across globally distributed teams. He is currently driving an AI-Enabled Quality Engineering Accelerator, exploring AI-assisted software engineering, Vibe Coding, intelligent test automation, and engineering productivity to help development teams deliver software faster while improving quality and resilience. As a panellist, Nipam brings practical insights into how retailers can modernise Quality Engineering, embrace AI responsibly, and build high-performing engineering organisations that enable rapid, reliable digital delivery.

mahesh-sathiamoorthy.bio: Mahesh Sathiamoorthy is the co-founder and CEO of Bespoke Labs, a data research lab that has raised $40M in Seed and Series A. Previously he was at Google DeepMind where he published seminal work in the intersection of LLMs and recommender systems, which are now being adopted widely in the recommender systems industry across the world.

safeena-banu.bio: Safeena Banu is a technology leader and AI enthusiast passionate about turning emerging technologies into meaningful business outcomes. Her focus spans Generative AI, cloud, solution architecture, and enterprise transformation, with a strong emphasis on designing solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient, and practical. She enjoys looking beyond individual AI tools and models to understand the bigger picture—how data, platforms, workflows, governance, and user experience come together to create intelligent systems. Through her work, learning, and knowledge-sharing, she aims to help professionals develop an architect's mindset: asking the right questions, making informed technology choices, and translating ambitious AI ideas into solutions that deliver real impact.

impu-chunchegowda.role: VP of Quality Engineering and Product
impu-chunchegowda.bio: Impu Chunchegowda is a seasoned technology leader with over 15 years of experience in Quality Engineering. She has built and led high-performing teams from the ground up, driving excellence in delivery and operational efficiency. In her current role as Vice President of Quality Engineering and Product Management at City Furniture, she oversees strategic portfolio management, enterprise-level roadmaps, and the integration of quality into every stage of product development. Passionate about building scalable processes, fostering cross-team collaboration, and accelerating value delivery, she is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards while enabling organizations to innovate and grow.

krystyna-sylyvonchyk.bio: Krystyna Sylyvonchyk holds an MBA in IT Management and has over 10 years of experience advocating for software quality. She is an expert in digital accessibility and compliance, and has successfully released financial mobile applications with more than 1 million users. She is passionate about shaping the future of quality through AI. Personal fun facts: Judo brown belt, Harry Potter fan, and she also holds a law degree.

jason-bryant.role: Director and Head of Software Quality Engineering and Assurance
jason-bryant.bio: Jason is a technology and quality assurance leader with nearly three decades of experience helping organizations build stronger software, teams, and testing practices. Across multiple industries—including five Fortune 500 environments—he has built QA teams from the ground up and guided organizations in evolving good practices into great ones. Recognized as an HP Enterprise Software Innovator of the Year and a frequent conference speaker, Jason brings particular passion and expertise to mobile testing. Above all, he is proud to be known as a Servant Leader—focused on empowering people, developing high-performing teams, and delivering quality that makes a meaningful impact.

mark-kroh.bio: Mark Kroh is a technology executive with more than twenty years of experience building and transforming software engineering organizations in highly regulated healthcare environments. A proven leader of global engineering teams responsible for consumer-facing digital health products, enterprise platforms, cloud modernization, engineering governance, accessibility, and responsible AI adoption, Mark currently leads an approximately 150-person engineering organization at RVO Health, a joint venture of Red Ventures and UnitedHealth Group/Optum, delivering digital health products serving millions of users while operating within HIPAA-regulated environments. Recognized for aligning engineering investments with business strategy, improving engineering economics, modernizing technology platforms, and building organizations that consistently deliver secure, reliable software at scale, Mark is known for developing engineering leaders, simplifying complex organizations, establishing governance without sacrificing innovation, and partnering with executive leadership to translate technology strategy into measurable business outcomes.

siddhant-sinha.bio: Siddhant is a Lead Member of Technical Staff at TestmuAI, where he builds the harness that runs test automation — not the tests, but the layer underneath: device orchestration, framework integrations, and real-device streaming at scale. He maintains Kane-CLI and Evidence-CLI, and has spent six years in the gap between what automation frameworks promise and what they do under load. He holds a B.Tech in Mathematics and Computing from IIT Guwahati. Off the clock: chess, and more cosmology than his physics background justifies.

andrew-duncan.bio: Andrew Duncan is an accomplished business leader and entrepreneur with more than 30 years of international experience across consulting, technology, and professional services. Recognised for driving sustained growth, managing complex transformations, and building high-performing teams, Andrew has driven innovative strategies for many of the world's most respected brands across global markets. Before joining QualityAI as Chief Executive Officer, Andrew served as CEO of Infosys Consulting, positioning the firm as one of the fastest growing and most profitable business units within the Infosys group. Under his direction, the organisation adopted a new operating model, strengthened its leadership through internal promotions and targeted external hires, and launched several cutting-edge service lines. The impact was significant: record-breaking revenues, double-digit annual growth, and market-leading profitability. His strategic vision and operational discipline helped drive exceptional client retention and significantly elevated the firm's profile across the C-suite, analyst, and media communities. Earlier in his career, Andrew held senior leadership roles at A.T. Kearney, AlixPartners, and Galphay, and co-founded a professional services firm that achieved rapid scale under his direction. He has delivered major initiatives in strategy, digital transformation, and organisational change across a wide range of industries, including financial services, retail, energy, and healthcare. Andrew holds a degree in Electrical Engineering from Imperial College London. A dual UK-US citizen, he was named a 'Global Leader in Consulting' by Consulting Magazine in 2022. He is frequently published in international media, a regular contributor to the Forbes Technology Council, and a sought-after speaker on the future of leadership, AI, and digital innovation.

senthil-kannan.bio: Senthil Kannan is a Quality Engineering and technology leader with more than 20 years of experience building and transforming quality, test automation, release engineering, and engineering productivity practices. He currently serves as a Quality Engineering Advisor supporting Vail Resorts, where he helps drive enterprise QE transformation and modernize quality practices across engineering teams. Previously, Senthil led Quality Engineering at Inspirato and held senior engineering leadership roles across cloud-native SaaS and technology organizations. His areas of focus include scalable test automation, continuous testing, shift-left quality, DevOps, engineering productivity, and the evolving role of AI in Quality Engineering. He is passionate about transforming QE from a testing function into an engineering capability that enables faster, more reliable software delivery.

akshit-lomash.bio: Akshit Lomash is an engineering leader with extensive experience building and growing teams in QA, quality engineering, and engineering productivity. He works with stakeholders across geographies to build a vision, roadmap, and release plan leading up to a quality software delivery. He is passionate about increasing developer productivity and making software delivery respond faster and more efficiently to business needs.

hammad-ahmed.bio: Hammad Ahmed is Head of QA AI Innovation at Aily Labs, leading the development of AI-powered and autonomous QA systems for a Decision Intelligence platform serving Fortune 500 enterprises. With 16+ years in software engineering and quality, Hammad focuses on agentic testing, AI quality evaluation, autonomous test automation, and enterprise quality intelligence. His mission is to move QA from reactive testing to proactive, autonomous quality engineering — using AI to test AI.

cem-sever.role: IT Service Acceptance & Test Senior Manager
cem-sever.bio: Cem Sever is a senior IT and telecommunications leader with over 25 years of expertise in Service Delivery and Acceptance, enterprise service management, and large-scale technology modernization programs. He currently serves in a senior leadership role at Vodafone Turkey, driving Service Acceptance and Testing, DevOps transformation, Automation initiatives, and large-scale technology delivery across complex, multi-vendor environments. He also has a strong background in customer interaction technologies and TV broadcasting infrastructure, with proven success in leading global-standard projects, improving operational efficiency, and managing cross-functional teams. He holds a degree in Electronics and Telecommunications Engineering and maintains multiple industry certifications including Lead Auditor for Business Continuity, ITIL, and ISO standards. He focuses on enabling innovation, accelerating time-to-market, and establishing scalable, future-ready technology ecosystems that enhance customer experience and business performance.

anamika-mukhopadhyay.bio: Anamika is a QA Consultant with over 13 years of experience in software testing and automation and leads Nagarro's Emerging and Special Tech Practice. Passionate about inclusivity and equal access to technology, she explores AI-driven innovations to advance testing practices. Her focus is on delivering sustainable, accessible, and high-quality solutions that empower diverse users across an evolving digital landscape.

manideep-singireddy.bio: Mani Deep Reddy is a Senior Manager and SDET Architect with 13+ years of experience transforming software quality through AI, intelligent automation, and scalable quality engineering. He specializes in AI-driven testing, automation architecture, UI/API/mobile/performance testing, and CI/CD across complex enterprise platforms. His automation strategies have delivered 40–50% gains in testing efficiency and helped reduce critical defects through shift-left practices and intelligent automation. A passionate technology leader and mentor, Mani drives innovation in AI-powered quality engineering, helping organizations build faster, smarter, and more reliable software.

thejes-sree-satheesh-kumar.bio: Thejes Sree Satheesh Kumar (She/Her) is a Quality Analyst - Consultant at Thoughtworks, specializing in application and AI security testing. She is a Certified Ethical Hacker and holds CompTIA Security+ and Google Cybersecurity Professional certifications. Thejes combines quality engineering and security practices to build resilient software systems. She is passionate about secure AI ecosystems and advancing defensive strategies for emerging technologies like the Model Context Protocol. Following deep-dive presentations at Nullcon Goa and TechXpresso, she is currently co-authoring the forthcoming book 'Breaking the Model Context Protocol: Agentic Attacks and Defenses for MCP-Powered AI Systems' (expected October 2026).

tanvi-mittal.bio: Tanvi Mittal is a Test Automation Lead and Software Quality Engineering professional with 15+ years of enterprise experience, currently driving AI-augmented testing strategy at U.S. Bank (U.S. Bancorp), one of the largest financial institutions in the United States. She architects large-scale automation frameworks across React and Angular ecosystems, integrates ML-driven test intelligence into production pipelines, and embeds quality engineering deep into DevOps and CI/CD workflows in highly regulated financial environments. An IEEE Senior Member, Tanvi has published peer-reviewed research on ethical AI governance for federated multi-agent systems and serves as a Technical Program Committee reviewer for ITU Kaleidoscope 2026. She is the creator of two open-source tools: LogMiner-QA, a privacy-preserving, AI-powered library for production-log-driven test generation, and PromptArmor, a prompt injection testing library covered under a USPTO provisional patent. Beyond her engineering work, Tanvi is the founder of HerNextTech, a community supporting early-career women in technology, the founding leader of BrowserStack's Cincinnati Chapter, and an active contributor to IEEE WIE.

swastik-baranwal.role: Member of Technical Staff - Open Source Engineer
swastik-baranwal.bio: Swastik Baranwal is a software developer from New Delhi, India, focused on open source, developer tooling, and community-driven software. He is the creator of Box CLI Maker, a Go library for rendering highly customizable boxes, used by Kubernetes' Minikube. He is also a core developer of the V Programming Language and maintains several open source projects in his spare time. Currently, he is part of the OSPO team at TestMu AI, where he contributes to Selenium, Appium, WebDriverIO, and other open source projects in the testing ecosystem.

navin-chandra.bio: Navin Chandra is a Member of Technical Staff at TestMu AI and an open source maintainer focused on mobile automation and browser automation. He is a Selenium Committer, a member of the Appium GitHub organization, and an active contributor across the Selenium and Appium ecosystems. His work spans WebDriver BiDi, browser automation, and iOS device communication, with contributions to projects including Selenium, Appium, appium-mcp, and appium-ios-remotexpc.

rhea-goel.bio: Rhea Goel is an Applied Science Manager at Amazon, where she leads the development of large-scale machine learning systems for ranking, recommendations, and personalization. Her work focuses on applied AI, production ML, and LLM-powered systems.

angela-cutulenco.role: Senior Director - Governance, Administration and Continuous Improvement
angela-cutulenco.bio: Angela Cutulenco is Senior Director of Governance, Administration and Continuous Improvement in the office of the CIO at the Toronto Transit Commission, one of North America's largest public transit systems. She has 33 years in IT and over 30 years in progressive leadership roles across quality management, IT service management, testing, and governance.
