She designed and implemented the TTC's first configuration management database and used it as the basis for change impact assessment, and spent six years as Supervisor of Change, Configuration and Release Management, chairing the weekly Change Advisory Board. She is Product Owner and subject matter expert for the TTC's integrated ServiceNow platform, spanning IT Service Management, IT Operations Management, IT Asset Management, Service Mapping, hardware and software asset management, automated discovery, and Strategic Portfolio Management. She is currently leading the deployment of an AI service desk analyst agent, which runs in parallel across non-production and production. In parallel she has led end-to-end testing and quality assurance across the TTC's SAP portfolio, including ECC, S/4HANA, SuccessFactors and Time and Attendance, delivering major production transitions with zero Priority 1 incidents and under two percent defect leakage. She began her career in international consulting with Price Waterhouse, Booz-Allen & Hamilton and KPMG in Moldova, and later implemented configuration management at TNK-BP in Moscow, the first implementation of its kind in Russia. She is an ITIL Expert and ITIL 4 Leader in Digital and IT Strategy, with additional training in COBIT, TOGAF, and information systems auditing. She holds an Executive MBA from the Ivey Business School at Western University.

shantanu-wali.bio: Shantanu Wali is the Director of Product Management at TestMu AI, where he leads the charge in building AI-native testing tools that catch bugs before they bite. With 7+ years in tech, he has scaled B2B SaaS products from scratch, including launching KaneAI, an AI agent for QA. An IIM Calcutta MBA alum and former backend engineer, Shantanu traded gears for growth strategies, proving that mechanical minds can master software magic. When he’s not mentoring teams or optimizing user flows, you’ll find him on a run or planning his next outing.

harleen-bedi.bio: Harleen is Chief Technology Officer for Quality Engineering, Infosys, bringing over 25 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Engineering, technical delivery, people leadership, and client engagement. She has been instrumental in shaping AI-led Quality Engineering strategy, incubating technology architect groups, and scaling innovation across enterprise transformation programs. Her expertise spans AI-first testing, cloud modernization, big data platforms, autonomous testing, digital enterprise initiatives, and customer experience transformation. She partners with executive stakeholders to translate business priorities into differentiated solutions, measurable outcomes, and scalable Quality Engineering offerings for global enterprises.

prashant-sharma.bio: Prashant is the Head of Developer Relations at Arm, where he leads the global mission to make Arm the platform of choice for developers building the next generation of computing — from AI at the edge and intelligent devices to cloud and emerging compute experiences. At Arm, Prashant works at the intersection of technology, developers, and ecosystems — building strategic partnerships, enabling early adopters, and creating programs that accelerate developer adoption at scale. Over his career, he has held leadership roles at Microsoft, Wix, and Qualcomm, building and scaling developer, community, and startup ecosystems around emerging technology platforms. Beyond Arm, Prashant is a Venture Partner at Mindset Ventures and an active advisor and seed investor, working with early-stage founders at the intersection of technology, product, and ecosystem growth. He lives in Seattle, where outside of technology he can usually be found exploring the expansive wilderness of the Pacific Northwest, buried in a good book, or discovering his next favorite wine.

gaurav-khurana.bio: Gaurav Khurana is a Senior Test Consultant at Microsoft and AI enthusiast with 15+ years in testing and automation. Recognized as Tester of the Year 2022 and a multiple-hackathon winner, he’s an active mentor and community builder who creates Udemy courses and YouTube series on GitHub Copilot, AI with Python, Azure DevOps, and API testing — all available at gauravkhurana.com.

srikanta-sahoo.bio: Srikanta Kumar Sahoo is an experienced technology professional specializing in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and software engineering. He is passionate about designing intelligent, scalable solutions that solve real-world business challenges. With expertise in LLMs, data-driven systems, backend development, and cloud technologies, he combines technical depth with strong leadership and problem-solving skills. He enjoys mentoring teams, exploring emerging technologies, and turning innovative ideas into reliable products.

navneet-goyal.bio: Navneet Goyal is a Senior Architect at UKG with 20+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Software Architecture, Resiliency, DevOps, and enterprise test automation. He has led large-scale QE and CI/CD transformations across 50+ teams, improving automation, release confidence, and engineering efficiency. His current focus is on applying AI to intelligent test execution, automation efficiency, and developer productivity. Navneet has previously worked with Amazon, Oracle, and Adobe Systems and has presented at international SQS conferences in Bilbao, Spain.

somu-suryanarayanan.bio: Somu Suryanarayanan is a Staff QA Automation Engineer at CookUnity, where he builds agentic test automation systems that run in production. He designed and shipped a mobile automation framework built on Appium and the MCP that took mobile coverage from zero to over 80% and reduced test authoring time from roughly six hours to about 10 minutes. He also built Test Studio, a repository-native platform that turns plain English requirements into Playwright tests. He is an IEEE member, a published author with work indexed in IEEE Xplore, and a peer reviewer and session chair for international conferences in computing and artificial intelligence. He has previously held engineering roles at Life360, MyVest, and PayPal.

vikul-gupta.bio: Vikul Gupta is a visionary technology leader driving innovation in digital engineering and AI transformation at QualityAI. As CTO for QualityAI North America, he has led the creation of next-generation AI and automation platforms that enhance software delivery and accelerate digital modernization for global clients. Under his leadership, QualityAI's NextGen Center of Excellence has grown into a 150-member global innovation hub, delivering cutting-edge solutions across cloud, DevOps, and GenAI. Vikul’s initiatives have earned industry recognition, including the CEO Award (2025) for exceptional impact on company growth and innovation. Before joining QualityAI, Vikul held technology leadership roles at Cognizant and HP Software, where he launched award-winning digital platforms, secured patents in AI-driven quality engineering, and drove large-scale digital transformation initiatives. He holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Telecommunications from the National Institute of Technology, Surat, and is a Certified SAFe 5 Agilist.

sunie-paul.role: Associate Vice President - AI QE Services
sunie-paul.bio: With over three decades of experience in quality engineering, digital transformation, and global delivery leadership, Sunie Paul brings deep expertise in quality engineering, workforce transformation, and driving business value through innovation and operational excellence. Sunie has driven large enterprise QE transformation programs, built and scaled high-performing global teams, and delivered transformational outcomes across different industries.

heena-purohit.bio: Heena is the Director of AI at Microsoft for Startups, where she focuses on discovering and supporting the world’s most promising Data and AI startups, and helping them succeed by partnering with the Microsoft ecosystem. Prior to that, she spent 15+ years building and scaling Enterprise AI products. She launched and scaled multiple AI products from 0 to 1 and was incubating a portfolio of GenAI startups at IBM’s Corporate incubator program. Outside work, she is dedicated to promoting gender diversity in AI and building the AI-powered future responsibly. She is a global AI speaker and a leading advocate for AI literacy, responsible AI, and gender diversity in technology, working to ensure we’re building the AI-powered future responsibly.

chase-norton.bio: Chase Norton is the Head of AI at Faros AI. A three-time founder and 18-year engineer, he has shipped at PayPal scale, led teams to GA in healthcare, and built and sold companies in AI agents and consumer commerce. He is also an independent security researcher focused on AI systems, evals, and the risks of epistemic monoculture in AI-generated code. Chase splits his time between Honolulu and the Bay.

itamar-friedman.bio: Itamar Friedman is the Founder and CEO of Qodo, building AI-powered code governance solutions after 20+ years leading machine learning innovation and competition-winning teams. His previous company was acquired by Alibaba, where he worked on large-scale AI-powered products and led initiatives in AI model usage and training automation.

patrick-vuong.bio: Patrick Vuong is the Director of Product Management and founding PM at Moderne, where he leads the shift from probabilistic AI to deterministic agentic workflows. Having spent his career evolving how developers collaborate with AI, he now builds the specialized tooling agents need to operate accurately, efficiently, and at production scale. By grounding agents in deterministic systems, he is helping bridge the gap between "experimental" AI and enterprise-grade execution.

nandini-srinivasan.bio: Nandini Srinivasan is Vice President of Quality Engineering at Motive, where she leads a global team across cloud platforms, mobile, AI/ML, and embedded and firmware systems, reporting directly to the CTO. She's spent more than 25 years building and scaling quality organizations across SaaS, manufacturing, fintech, and IoT — and along the way, she's redefined what QA even means: from a test-execution function to a direct production-code contributor, with her team shipping hundreds of production fixes and running AI agents in production before her company's AI mandate existed. Her philosophy of quality pivots around the four-vector reliability framework she built — availability, scalability, quality, and performance. A recognized voice on quality, AI, and technology leadership, she takes the stage at TestMu to make the case that quality was never really about the tests.

haritha-sreedharan-nair.bio: Haritha has been building in the AI/ML space for the past 10 years. She is currently building Oqoqo, the first platform to bring research principles of evals and benchmarking to individuals, pioneering how agent interfaces will be built and evaluated in the future. Before being an entrepreneur, Haritha led enterprise products at Windsurf (acq. Cognition), building agentic coding tools for customers including Fortune 500s. She has built several sales tech products and developer tools during her tenure at Microsoft and has publications in reinforcement learning and neural architecture search.

rohit-jaiswal.bio: Rohit Jaiswal is a Healthcare Practice Lead at UST, where he drives Quality Engineering transformation for leading U.S. healthcare payers. With 15+ years in the payer ecosystem spanning claims adjudication, payment integrity, and member experience, Rohit brings a practitioner's lens to the intersection of AI and software quality. He currently leads efforts to embed agentic AI into the QE lifecycle — from intelligent test generation and autonomous defect triage to AI-powered UAT governance — helping clients modernize how they deliver and assure critical healthcare platforms. Rohit has hands-on experience architecting multi-agent workflows that integrate with enterprise toolchains like Azure DevOps, Jira, and qTest, and is passionate about upskilling QE teams to work alongside AI rather than be replaced by it.

hina-saini.bio: Hina is a Lead Quality Engineer at TUI with 18 years of experience in quality engineering, test automation, and digital transformation. She leads the Mobile QA function, driving scalable quality practices and engineering excellence. Passionate about the role of AI in quality engineering, Hina focuses on using intelligent automation to improve testing efficiency, product reliability, and customer experience.

rahul-nethi.bio: Rahul Nethi is a Lead QA Engineer at Little Caesars with a passion for quality engineering and test automation, helping teams deliver reliable, high-quality web and mobile applications. With extensive experience in software quality assurance, Rahul specializes in designing and implementing scalable automation frameworks across web and mobile platforms. Beyond functional and UI testing, Rahul specializes in performance engineering, focusing on application scalability, reliability, and responsiveness under real-world and high-traffic conditions. By combining automation, performance testing, and modern quality engineering practices, he helps teams deliver seamless, dependable customer experiences.

todd-lemmonds.bio: Todd Lemmonds is a Principal Solutions Architect at TestMu AI with over 25 years of experience leading quality engineering and software delivery across Fortune 500 organizations, including Boeing, Disney/ABC, Western Union, and the LA Rams. An early Agile adopter, he has built and scaled enterprise QA organizations while driving modern engineering practices from IT operations to executive quality leadership. Today, Todd specializes in Agentic Quality Engineering, helping teams move beyond traditional test automation by designing AI-powered systems that autonomously generate test cases, self-heal test suites, execute across real devices at scale, and enable risk-based release decisions. His current work focuses on one of the industry's most important challenges: validating non-deterministic AI systems through agent-to-agent testing.

rama-gunjaipalli.bio: Rama Gunjaipalli brings over 20 years of experience in software testing and quality engineering, with extensive expertise across the Software Development Life Cycle and a strong focus on the e-commerce domain. Throughout his career, he has led and delivered large-scale, complex transformation programs, including initiatives with budgets exceeding $200 million. Passionate about building high-performing QA organizations, he has mentored and coached numerous individuals and teams, helping them elevate their capabilities and drive a culture of quality. He has also been instrumental in adopting emerging trends, technologies, and modern quality practices using AI to continuously improve software delivery, testing effectiveness, and customer outcomes.

ninad-p-shirodkar.role: VP, Solutions Consulting - BFSI & Quality Engineering
ninad-p-shirodkar.bio: Ninad P. Shirodkar is Vice President – Solutions Consulting (BFSI) at Persistent Systems, with over 30 years of experience building test strategies and winning solutions for the world's leading financial institutions. Across Persistent, Capgemini (IGATE-Patni), Infosys, and Mastek, he has led BFSI pre-sales, solution consulting, and Quality Engineering practices — helping win deals worth more than $550M over the last six years alone, while building Testing Centers of Excellence and automation frameworks for banks, broker-dealers, and insurers across the US, UK, Europe, and Asia. A recognized authority on test strategy and QE-led solutioning in financial services, Ninad brings a rare blend of technical depth and commercial acumen to the panel.

krishna-c-gangu.bio: Krishna C Gangu is a Distinguished Architect at Catalyst Brands (JCPenney, Brooks Brothers, Aeropostale, Lucky Brand, Nautica), where he leads platform and ecommerce architecture across a portfolio of retail brands and contributes to AI adoption across the enterprise. He has spent more than 12 years scaling JCPenney's digital platform through its move to cloud-native, API-first architecture, and over two decades building commerce systems for retailers across the US and Europe, spanning the retail, banking, and telecom domains. A MACH Alliance Ambassador and former IEEE Senior Member, he works at the intersection of composable architecture, distributed systems, and delivery excellence. He is based in Texas, and serves as president of a social welfare organization in Telangana, India.

kumar-gaurav-jain.bio: Kumar is Head of Quality for Digital at Virgin Media O2, where he leads quality strategy across the full digital estate from customer-facing journeys and eCommerce to the platforms that power them. Kumar's remit spans performance and reliability at scale, end-to-end journey assurance, and readiness for peak traffic events on complex cloud and API-driven architectures. Alongside core quality leadership, Kumar drives innovation and the adoption of AI within quality engineering, helping teams modernise how digital products are tested, assured, and shipped. Kumar partners closely with development, platform, and identity teams to balance speed of delivery with reliability at scale, and shares practitioner lessons on building quality approaches that hold up in real production environments.

javier-solano.bio: Javier Solano is an experienced Executive Leader and Technology Director with a proven track record of driving digital transformation, technology strategy, and complex software delivery in the financial services and fintech sectors. With deep domain knowledge in banking modernization, Javier has successfully led multidisciplinary engineering and product teams to build resilient, high-performance financial systems. His expertise spans modern software architecture, risk mitigation, regulatory compliance, and orchestrating digital initiatives that connect legacy core infrastructure with next-generation agentic AI applications.

mauricio-sanchez.bio: Mauricio Sánchez is an accomplished Technology and Artificial Intelligence Leader with extensive expertise in software architecture, enterprise system design, and AI-driven transformation. He specializes in designing and operationalizing high-availability, scalable digital platforms within complex business ecosystems. Over the years, Mauricio has spearheaded key engineering initiatives focusing on integrating emerging technologies, agentic AI frameworks, and intelligent automation into core enterprise workflows. His strategic focus centers on bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI innovation and robust, production-grade quality.

humberto-henriquez.bio: Humberto Henríquez is a seasoned Director of Engineering and Technology Leader with extensive expertise in software architecture, enterprise system design, and modernizing complex banking infrastructure. He specializes in designing resilient, high-availability financial applications and integrating next-generation AI and agentic systems into mission-critical environments. Throughout his career, Humberto has led high-performing engineering teams focused on quality engineering, non-deterministic system validation, and strict regulatory compliance. His strategic focus centers on establishing robust technical frameworks that ensure scalability, security, and operational excellence for large-scale financial solutions.

meenakshi-singh.bio: Meenakshi Singh is a Senior Program Lead at Google Customer Solutions with over 10 years of experience in the tech industry, designing and executing impactful growth marketing campaigns for both start-ups and Fortune 500 companies. An experienced product marketing leader specializing in Google Ads strategies, she has a proven track record of driving customer acquisition for diverse advertisers by carefully understanding audience personas, crafting compelling messaging, and leveraging the right channels to meet customers where they are. Meenakshi believes effective marketing is both an art and a science — it takes creative intuition and rigorous testing to hit the sweet spot — and her approach of combining analytical thinking with creative strategy to align marketing goals with tangible business outcomes has driven substantial incremental revenue. Formerly at Amazon and Paytm India, she delivered impactful ecommerce category growth and marketing strategies that drove customer engagement and revenue growth.
